components.name: IconButton
components.description: A button showing only an icon, the caller's SVG tinted with the button's text color, its label naming it and showing as its tooltip: macOS's bordered push button with an image, Windows 11's Button with a 16-DIP icon, or GNOME's 34-pixel image button; in a Toolbar, the platform's image item (an NSToolbar image item, an icon-only AppBarButton, a flat image button).

components.name: PasswordField
components.description: A single-line field hiding its text in the platform's text field: macOS's NSSecureTextField, Windows 11's PasswordBox with its RevealButton (shown while text typed since the focus came, revealing while pressed or Alt+F8 is held), or GNOME's GtkPasswordEntry with Show Text in its context menu.

components.name: SplitButton
components.description: A button of two parts, the main action, which Clicked reports, and an arrow opening the system's own menu: macOS's NSComboButton of style split, Windows 11's SplitButton, or GNOME's AdwSplitButton; in a Toolbar, the platform's toolbar split button.
